test_throw_on_failure_mode: test the throw-on-failure mode by running googletest-throw-on-failure-test_ with different environment and flag combinations
test_env_var_override: test that GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable enables or disables throw-on-failure behavior
test_flag_override: test that --gtest_throw_on_failure flag overrides GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable
test_default_behavior: test the default behavior of throw-on-failure mode when no environment variable or flag is set
run_test_subprocess: run a subprocess command and return True if exit code is zero, False otherwise
